hash: unmasked SipHash64 of uint64 little-endian (official example representation); full 64-bit hash seeds official mapping
keys: same two public seed-derived keys as each original formal Rateless trial; transmitted 16 bytes in session header

codec.attribution: based on paper section 6, not provided by official source
codec.frames: 32-bit little-endian symbol slot containing 30-bit value and 2 zero padding bits; 64-bit little-endian hash; signed residual VLQ
codec.header: version byte, symbol width byte, 16 hash-key bytes, N unsigned LEB128
codec.ordering: reliable ordered byte stream, index implicit starting at zero, VLQ self-delimits frames, no per-symbol index or frame length
codec.padding: 2 bits per symbol, explicitly accounted; network/TCP headers excluded like original application payload convention
codec.negative_and_rounding: experiment conventions; unspecified in paper and absent in official source

input: exact original formal full dataset bytes, SHA256 verified by engine each run; no success filtering in 100-sample communication cohort
stop: official Decoder.Decoded() after AddCodedSymbol and TryDecode; always send at least symbol0, truth only afterwards

limits.failures: retained, no retries; no new calibration

timing: serial after communication, CLOCK_THREAD_CPUTIME_ID, GOMAXPROCS1, thread locked; separately ingest A/B, Alice generation, receive-side local encoding plus peeling, wire encode/decode; total includes instrumentation and wire SHA; truth/data reading outside
pilot: communication d100000 trial0; then remaining cohort including all original failures
uncertainty: 10000 deterministic bootstrap resamples of independent communication samples or five timing dataset means; also sample SD, retained limits, Wilson success CI
